content: Diabetes Care and Education Specialists (DCES), including registered nurses, nurse practitioners, registered dietitian nutritionists (RDNs), and pharmacists, play a pivotal role in delivering Diabetes Self-Management Education and Support (DSMES). These professionals not only provide critical education about diabetes but also customize educational curricula to address the unique needs of individual patients. Members of the DSMES team are specifically trained in diabetes management and behavioral change strategies, equipping them to support patients in making sustainable lifestyle adjustments. Additionally, they may serve as technology advocates within their practices, helping patients integrate and utilize diabetes-related technologies effectively. DCES are strongly encouraged to pursue certification through organizations such as the Certification Board for Diabetes Care and Education (CBDCE). Achieving this certification enhances their expertise and ensures they deliver high-quality, evidence-based care to individuals managing diabetes.
